articles.summary: The combined structural & stratigraphic trap sealed by the Zorritos Unconformity covers 46 km2. Shallow water target ~80m water depth. Sealing Cardalitos shales above the Zorritos Unconformity and intra-formational shale seals within the Zorritos.
